name: yt-topic-filter
description: YT Topic Filter — local NLI zero-shot topic classification (Brave extension). Bun bundles the service worker; the bundle is committed so Load-unpacked needs no build.

scripts.build: bun build src/background.js --outfile=src/background.bundle.js --minify --target=browser && bun build src/offscreen.js --outfile=src/offscreen.bundle.js --minify --target=browser
